data.name: Magha
data.long_meaning: Magha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'magnam', which means 'great' or 'large'. In Hindu mythology, the month of Magha is named after the god Maghavan, an alternate name for Indra, the god of rain and thunder. The name Magha is associated with the brightness and radiance of the moon and is considered an auspicious name for a girl.
